facts.value: If you are considering a career in teaching and have a strong interest in science, this may be the course for you. This four-year programme attracts students who have excellent communication skills, and are strongly motivated and passionate about science teaching.

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Overview

facts.value: Graduates of the degree programme are eligible for appointment to all second level schools (vocational, secondary, community and comprehensive schools), and for registration with the Teaching Council. The primary aim of the programme is the attainment of a professional competence in teaching, and the majority of graduates pursue a career in second-level science teaching.

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Overview

facts.value: The aim of the programme is to educate young teachers and help them develop the skills and aptitudes to confidently face the challenges of science teaching.
